title: Recursion quizzes with tiered GPT-4 feedback
summary: CS3 students complete four low-stakes, 15-minute programming quizzes on recursion and algorithmic complexity. GPT-4 evaluates concept, syntax, and complexity, then chooses whether to build on the student's code, provide an efficient solution, or restart with guiding questions.

sources.title: Using GPT-4 to Provide Tiered, Formative Code Feedback
sources.evidence_quote: In this paper, we test the model's capacity with four programming questions focusing on recursion.

assessment.summary: Solve four short recursion problems involving binary arrays, trees, median selection, and subset sum.
student_actions: Write code or pseudocode for four recursion problems.
Review tiered feedback on concept, syntax, complexity, code, and next steps.

student_role.description: The quiz format prevents outside help; the reported study generated GPT-4 feedback on prior submissions for instructor evaluation.

grading.method: Completion points; the instructor grades a random third of submissions and provides detailed feedback.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
